annotations.title: Create or replace a tracked prompt

description: Creates or replaces a tracked prompt — the whole model list and schedule, not single fields. On every scheduled check the SAME prompt is re-run (grounded, for real citations) and diffed against the previous check. Requires the admin role in the calling organization, because it starts UNATTENDED RECURRING spend from the shared AI-gateway monthly budget. Confirm the schedule and models with the user before calling.

brandTarget.description: The brand whose mentions and citations are tracked.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

prompt.description: The prompt to re-run on every check.

scheduleInterval.description: How often the prompt is re-checked.

name: upsert_tracked_prompt
